at.description: LOG-4. When the Worker recorded it, as an RFC 3339 instant carrying an offset. LOG-6: it does not establish the order and a caller never sorts by it — records written inside one request routinely carry the same millisecond, and no resolution fixes that.

message.description: LOG-4. Human-readable, and parsed by nothing. The reader this surface exists for is a person who came looking for what happened; what a program acts on is the level.

fields.description: LOG-9. One level deep, values scalar. Nesting is what turns a rendering into a tree widget and what tempts a reader to reach into it; a flat map can be shown, scanned and copied into a ticket, and offers nothing to build a contract on. This protocol defines no filter over it.

title: Log record
description: LOG-4. One thing the Worker recorded while it was working.
